mathematical_meanings: Left image: The graph segment indicates that the temperature remains 100 °C during that time interval. Right image: The horizontal piece plots constant area S = 16 over that time interval.
Rationales: In both images the feature plots a constant function output over an interval. The solid flat part of the temperature trace at 100 °C. The flat top of the plotted trace between t = 4 and t = 8, at S = 16.
